visualCharacteristics: 4 equal items: icon, 2-line heading, outline button
contentPattern: One row per item: cell 1 = BMW icon-font icon (:icon_name:, e.g. :car_front_double:), cell 2 = h3 heading + italic link (outline/secondary button). 4 columns from 1024px, 2 columns below; icon, heading and CTA centered, CTAs bottom-aligned.
